Subject: Mutual action plan & security gating for Pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. Before we can sign the pilot SOW we need to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and the security/compliance gates. Two quick asks so we can confirm internal funding and legal: 

- SOC 2: do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report we can share with our security team?
- SIG / CAIQ: can you complete the CAIQ or share your completed SIG matrix? I attached our template (VanguardPay-SIG-2026.xlsx) with a few initial questions.
- DPA / retention: we have two sticking points — a 7 year requirement for transactional financial logs and a 90-day retention for AI prompt/analysis traces. We’ll need to understand how Redwood classifies these and whether an exception is possible.

Our timeline is tight: procurement wants a signed plan and SOW by 21 Jul. Can you propose a MAP with owners, milestones, and acceptance criteria (SOC 2 evidence, SIG answers, DPA redline) that gets us to signature by then?

Thanks,
Alex Hale
Head of Platform Security
VanguardPay

Hi Alex — thanks, really glad the demo resonated.

Attached is a draft MAP (Redwood-MAP-draft-20260711.pdf) with concrete owners and a compressed acceptance lane to meet your 21 Jul target. High level: 
- Week 1 (now–16 Jul): SOC 2 report delivery (redacted), SIG/CAIQ self-assessment, and DPA term sheet. Owners: Naomi (security evidence), Kimberly (legal/DPA).
- Week 2 (17–20 Jul): VanguardPay review window, legal redlines, final acceptance criteria check.
- 21 Jul: mutual sign-off and SOW counter-sign.

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- SOC 2: provide current Type II report and shared redaction policy; security team signs off on no open network control exceptions.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed CAIQ spreadsheet for production controls; outstanding items are tagged P1/P2 with mitigation notes.
- DPA: Redwood provides DPA with retention fields editable; we propose 90 days for model logs and 7 years for canonical transaction records (we flagged potential operational impacts).

I’ve kept the MAP intentionally prescriptive to reduce back-and-forth. Naomi — can you confirm SOC 2 availability and the earliest we can produce the redacted report for VanguardPay?

Alex — if you can confirm owners on your side (legal + security), I’ll push the MAP into our shared drive and route the DPA to Kimberly for a fast review.

Next steps:
1) Naomi to attach SOC 2 redacted by end of day 11 Jul.
2) Redwood completes CAIQ answers and shares by 13 Jul.
3) Kimberly to send DPA term sheet by 14 Jul.

Thanks,

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Hale <alex.hale@vanguardpay.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security gating for Pilot

Alex / team — quick status from security side.

- SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II (covering Security and Availability) for the period ending 2026-05-31. We can produce a redacted copy suitable for vendor review by EOD 11 Jul. Redactions will remove customer names and IPs; we can also provide a control-mapping summary for your internal controls team.
- SIG/CAIQ: Redwood will complete the CAIQ answers and flag any controls that require compensating controls or procedural evidence. Expect the initial CAIQ export by 13 Jul.
- Retention: on classification — typically: 
  * Transactional financial records (ledger events, settlement files) are canonical records and we can support customer-specified retention (we normally provision long-term storage buckets and legal hold hooks).
  * Model inputs/outputs and prompt traces are operational telemetry, stored by default for 90 days and purged per retention policy; we can offer a 365-day extended window as an add-on, but 7 years for prompt-level traces is operationally significant and will need an exception + SSO/archival plan.

If VanguardPay requires 7 years for prompts specifically, we’ll need to scope storage, encryption-at-rest tiers, and potential KMS/HSM usage; Kimberly — can legal start modeling an exception clause and costs?

I’ll attach the SOC 2 redacted PDF to the shared drive after I run it by our compliance counsel.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi and Jonas — that helps. A couple clarifications from our side before we lock: 

1) Retention split: VanguardPay can accept 365 days for prompt traces as a commercial compromise, but procurement will push for 7 years for transaction-level audit trails. Can Redwood confirm that transaction-level exports can be delivered in a format we can archive off-platform if needed?

2) CAIQ: Priya (CC’d) will review your answers. We need the CAIQ completed by 13 Jul to avoid a legal hold-up.

3) DPA: our legal team will redline the DPA with a retention annex. Can Kimberly confirm whether Redwood typically accepts retention annexes per-account or if you need to standardize?

If we can get SOC 2 + CAIQ by EOD 13 Jul and a DPA term sheet by 14 Jul, we’ll proceed to internal sign-off and aim for 21 Jul. Appreciate the fast turn.

—Alex
